arm_a.condition: Loaded skill verification-before-completion through the skill tool

interpretation: Native lazy loading avoids preloading the 228k-token estimated skill bodies, but loading a skill incurs a separate tool round-trip/inference with context resend. The approximately 34k prompt difference reflects resend/cache behavior, not the skill body size. Do not interpret this one-pair sample as a causal latency or token benchmark.
conclusion: No new platform or flag is warranted; skill_routing remains OFF. A skill load is on-demand and costs a round-trip. #64 remains PARTIAL because this is one MiMo free sample per arm and not a skills-assisted completion journey.
limitations: One observation per arm; no statistical inference.
No full completion/DONE journey with a loaded skill was measured.
Reported cost 0 is the observed call cost, not a universal free-cost claim.
Prompt token difference reflects context resend/cache and is not the skill payload size.
